answer: A Registered domain bound by in-person pickup code with one identity per channel turns a private channel into public evidence: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. A dune out of place triggers the check: the claim is frozen until its channel clears. A zephyr alone is noise; a trellis of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
